rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a lamp when the type is clear from context.

example.english: I turned on the lamp to read at night.
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 tai2 syu1 ngo5 hoi1 zo2 zaan2 dang1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean an electric lamp or electric light rather than an oil lamp.

example.english: After the power came back, the electric lamp lit up and the whole room became bright.
example.traditional: 停電之後，電燈一着返，成間屋即刻光晒。
example.jyutping: ting4 din6 zi1 hau6 din6 dang1 jat1 zoek3 faan1 seng4 gaan1 uk1 zik1 hak1 gwong1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the light bulb itself, rather than the whole lamp or light fitting.

example.english: The lamp bulb has blown, so I need to buy a new one.
example.traditional: 個燈膽燒咗，我要買個新嘅。
example.jyutping: go3 dang1 daam2 siu1 zo2 ngo5 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a lamp that burns oil through a wick.

example.english: In the old days, people in the countryside relied on an oil lamp to see the way at night.
example.traditional: 以前鄉下冇電，夜晚要靠油燈照路。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 haa6 mou5 din6 je6 maan5 jiu3 kaau3 jau4 dang1 ziu3 lou6
